# PhysioClinStats

Clinical inference engine for the
[x-biosignal](https://github.com/x-biosignal) ecosystem:
mixed-effects/MMRM longitudinal models, single-case (N-of-1) designs,
estimands with multiple imputation, causal mediation, declared
target-trial emulation, and per-estimate uncertainty. Heavy modelling
backends are optional (guarded) Suggests.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("PhysioClinStats",
  repos = c("https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

## Causal mediation

``` r

if (requireNamespace("mediation", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data(jobs, package = "mediation")
  model_m <- lm(job_seek ~ treat + econ_hard + sex + age, data = jobs)
  model_y <- lm(
    depress2 ~ treat + job_seek + econ_hard + sex + age,
    data = jobs
  )
  result <- causalMediation(
    model_m, model_y,
    treat = "treat", mediator = "job_seek",
    sims = 1000, seed = 481
  )
  PhysioCore::resultValue(result)$effects
}
```

The estimates require sequential ignorability, consistency, positivity,
no treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder, and correctly
specified models. An indirect effect is not proof of a biological
mechanism.

## Target-trial emulation

``` r

protocol <- targetTrialProtocol(
  eligibility = function(data) data$eligible,
  treatment_strategies = list(never = 0, always = 1),
  assignment = "clone eligible participants",
  time_zero = 0,
  follow_up = 12,
  outcome = "recovery by week 12",
  causal_contrast = "always versus never",
  analysis_plan = "clone-censor-weight"
)

result <- targetTrialEmulate(
  longitudinal_data, protocol,
  id = "participant", time = "week", treatment = "treated",
  outcome = "recovered",
  baseline_covariates = c("age", "baseline_score"),
  time_varying_covariates = "current_score",
  estimand = "per_protocol"
)
PhysioCore::resultValue(result)$effects
```

Time zero and every protocol component are declared rather than
inferred. Inspect positivity, balance, censoring, and
raw-versus-analysis weight diagnostics before interpreting a contrast.
Cox hazard ratios are non-collapsible and are not marginal risk ratios.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ESTIMAND_STRATEGIES`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/ESTIMAND_STRATEGIES.md)
  : Valid ICH E9(R1) intercurrent-event strategies
- [`analyseEstimand()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/analyseEstimand.md)
  : Analyse an estimand under multiple imputation for dropout
- [`bayesEstimate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/bayesEstimate.md)
  : Bayesian estimate of a mean (conjugate Normal-Normal or Stan)
- [`causalMediation()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/causalMediation.md)
  : Model-based causal mediation analysis
- [`clinStatsBackends()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/clinStatsBackends.md)
  : Which optional modelling backends are available
- [`conformalInterval()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/conformalInterval.md)
  : Conformal prediction interval for a fitted model
- [`conformalPredict()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/conformalPredict.md)
  : Conformal prediction band for a single new patient
- [`coxModel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/coxModel.md)
  : Cox proportional-hazards model with a PH check
- [`credibleInterval()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/credibleInterval.md)
  : Credible interval from posterior samples
- [`defineEstimand()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/defineEstimand.md)
  : Define an ICH E9(R1) estimand
- [`doseResponse()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/doseResponse.md)
  : Therapy dose-response model
- [`estimatedMarginalMeans()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/estimatedMarginalMeans.md)
  : Estimated marginal means
- [`fitMMRM()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/fitMMRM.md)
  : Fit a mixed model for repeated measures (MMRM)
- [`fitMixedModel()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/fitMixedModel.md)
  : Fit a linear mixed-effects model
- [`latentClassGrowth()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/latentClassGrowth.md)
  : Latent-class growth analysis of longitudinal trajectories
- [`milestoneHazard()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/milestoneHazard.md)
  : Hazard ratio for attaining a milestone
- [`multipleImputation()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/multipleImputation.md)
  : Multiply impute missing data
- [`pairwiseContrasts()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/pairwiseContrasts.md)
  : Pairwise contrasts of estimated marginal means
- [`peToLong()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/peToLong.md)
  : Reshape a longitudinal PhysioExperiment to long format
- [`poolEstimates()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/poolEstimates.md)
  : Pool estimates across imputations (Rubin's rules)
- [`proportionalRecoveryRule()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/proportionalRecoveryRule.md)
  : Evaluate the proportional recovery rule with an artefact guard
- [`recoveryTrajectoryLME()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/recoveryTrajectoryLME.md)
  : Fit a population recovery-trajectory NLME
- [`requireBackend()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/requireBackend.md)
  : Require an optional backend or stop with guidance
- [`scedABAB()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedABAB.md)
  : Analyse an ABAB (reversal) single-case design
- [`scedCelerationLine()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedCelerationLine.md)
  : Celeration (trend) line for a single-case phase
- [`scedNAP()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedNAP.md)
  : Non-overlap of all pairs (NAP)
- [`scedPEM()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedPEM.md)
  : Percentage exceeding the median (PEM)
- [`scedPND()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedPND.md)
  : Percentage of non-overlapping data (PND)
- [`scedTau()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedTau.md)
  : Tau non-overlap (Tau)
- [`scedTauU()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedTauU.md)
  : Tau-U with baseline-trend correction
- [`scedTwoSDBand()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/scedTwoSDBand.md)
  : Two-standard-deviation band decision rule
- [`survivalFit()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/survivalFit.md)
  : Kaplan-Meier survival fit with attainment-time summary
- [`targetTrialEmulate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/targetTrialEmulate.md)
  : Emulate a declared target trial
- [`targetTrialProtocol()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/targetTrialProtocol.md)
  : Declare a target-trial protocol
- [`timeToMilestone()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioClinStats/reference/timeToMilestone.md)
  : Derive a time-to-milestone survival endpoint
